metadata.title: Global Macro Economy Pressure & Expansion Radar
metadata.regime_headline: Global Asymmetric Divergence: US AI Capex vs European Industrial Slump & China Stimulus
metadata.global_conclusion: Global economic momentum is sharply fractured. The United States maintains resilient services and an unprecedented $250B+ AI infrastructure capex wave. Europe remains gripped by severe industrial de-leveraging (German auto & chemical crisis). China is deploying massive ¥10 Trillion fiscal bond stimulus to combat housing deflation, while India and Southeast Asia expand as the primary China+1 supply chain beneficiaries.

executive_hud.health_verdict: Real global physical output is sustained by Emerging Asian manufacturing and US tech spending, offset by European contraction.

core_pillars.key_driver: German Auto Crisis & High Energy Cost

pressure_points.title: US 10-Year Yield Spike (~4.4%)
pressure_points.description: High long-term Treasury yields increase global borrowing costs and put persistent valuation pressure on high-PE equities worldwide.

pressure_points.title: $35.8 Trillion Sovereign Debt Burden
pressure_points.description: Annual federal interest servicing has crossed $1.1 Trillion, restricting long-term fiscal headroom and driving credit rating downgrade risks.

pressure_points.title: Commercial Real Estate (CRE) Distress
pressure_points.description: Work-from-home vacancies in metropolitan office towers continue to weigh on regional US banks.

expansion_engines.title: $250B+ AI Data Center & Compute Supercycle
expansion_engines.description: Hyperscalers (Microsoft, Meta, Google, Amazon, Oracle) are executing the largest technological capex ramp-up in modern history.

expansion_engines.title: Federal Reserve Rate Cut Cycle
expansion_engines.description: Easing policy rate injects liquidity into capital markets, lowering refinancing friction for midcap corporates.

expansion_engines.title: Resilient Consumer Balance Sheets
expansion_engines.description: Real wage growth has turned positive as headline inflation cools down, sustaining retail consumption.

pressure_points.title: Real Estate Liquidation & Wealth Erosion
pressure_points.description: Over 70% of Chinese household wealth was tied to property. Persistent price declines have triggered severe consumer sentiment depression.

pressure_points.title: Producer Price Deflation (-2.9% PPI)
pressure_points.description: Industrial overcapacity has ignited vicious domestic price wars in electric vehicles, solar panels, and lithium batteries.

pressure_points.title: Western Tariff Barriers & Trade Friction
pressure_points.description: US and EU imposing 50-100% tariffs on Chinese EVs and solar cells to protect domestic industrial bases.

expansion_engines.title: ¥10 Trillion Local Debt Swap & Fiscal Stimulus
expansion_engines.description: Beijing announced a historic debt-relief swap program to unfreeze municipal budgets and stimulate infrastructure dispatches.

expansion_engines.title: Global Clean-Tech Export Dominance
expansion_engines.description: Controlling >80% of global solar ingot, wafer, and LFP battery supply chains, flooding Global South markets.

expansion_engines.title: Semiconductor Self-Sufficiency Ramp-up
expansion_engines.description: Domestic fab capacity expanding at 25% YoY to bypass US export restrictions (SMIC, Huawei ecosystem).

pressure_points.title: German Industrial De-Industrialization
pressure_points.description: Volkswagen planning historic domestic factory closures, BASF scaling back chemical production due to 3x higher natural gas costs vs US.

pressure_points.title: French & British Fiscal Austerity
pressure_points.description: Deficit overruns forcing tax hikes and public spending cuts, directly depressing consumer discretionary demand.

pressure_points.title: High Energy Transition Penalties
pressure_points.description: Heavy carbon border tariffs and expensive renewable grid integration making heavy manufacturing uncompetitive.

expansion_engines.title: Rapid ECB Rate Cuts Ahead of US Fed
expansion_engines.description: Lagarde accelerating rate reductions (expecting <2.25% by mid-2025) to provide urgent monetary CPR to the mortgage and auto sectors.

expansion_engines.title: European Defense Capex Supercycle
expansion_engines.description: NATO members increasing defense budgets to >2.5% of GDP, driving record backlogs for Rheinmetall, BAE Systems, and Airbus.

expansion_engines.title: Southern Europe Tourism & Services
expansion_engines.description: Spain, Portugal, and Greece maintaining 2.0%+ GDP growth on record international tourism and service exports.

pressure_points.title: Yen Carry Trade Unwinding Flashpoints
pressure_points.description: When the Bank of Japan hikes rates while the Fed cuts, the Yen strengthens rapidly, triggering algorithmic margin calls across global asset markets.

pressure_points.title: Import Fuel & Food Inflation
pressure_points.description: Weak historical Yen has driven up import costs for Japanese households and small-medium manufacturing enterprises.

expansion_engines.title: Historic 30-Year Wage Growth (Shunto +5.2%)
expansion_engines.description: Japanese conglomerates agreed to the largest wage increases since 1991, successfully ending three decades of deflationary stagnation.

expansion_engines.title: Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) Corporate Reform
expansion_engines.description: Mandatory push for companies trading below 1x P/B to initiate buybacks, boost dividends, and eliminate cross-shareholdings.

expansion_engines.title: Semiconductor Mega-Fabs (Kumamoto & Rapidus)
expansion_engines.description: TSMC's multi-billion dollar fab deployments establishing Japan as a leading advanced packaging hub.

pressure_points.title: Strong US Dollar Currency Depletion
pressure_points.description: A rising DXY (>106) puts pressure on Emerging Market currencies, forcing central banks to use forex reserves to cushion currency volatility.

pressure_points.title: Middle East Energy Geopolitics
pressure_points.description: Over 85% of crude oil is imported; any escalation near the Strait of Hormuz directly threatens domestic trade deficits.

expansion_engines.title: China+1 High-Tech Manufacturing Relocation
expansion_engines.description: Apple now produces 1 in 7 iPhones in India. Foxconn, Pegatron, and Dixon ramping up domestic electronics assembly at scale.

expansion_engines.title: Domestic Physical Infrastructure Capex
expansion_engines.description: Central government deploying ₹11.11 Lakh Crore in physical capex (highways, dedicated freight corridors, renewables).

expansion_engines.title: Systematic Retail Inflow Financialization
expansion_engines.description: Domestic monthly SIPs of ₹25,000+ Cr insulate Indian capital markets from foreign institutional panic exits.

global_stress_gauges.name: US Dollar Index (DXY)
global_stress_gauges.market_impact: When DXY crosses 105, foreign institutional investors (FIIs) pull liquidity out of Emerging Markets. Strong dollar raises the cost of dollar-denominated debt for Asian and Latin American corporates.

global_stress_gauges.name: US 10-Year Treasury Yield
global_stress_gauges.market_impact: The global risk-free discount rate. Yields above 4.3% suck capital back into US money market funds and trigger valuation compression for expensive growth stocks globally.

global_stress_gauges.name: Brent Crude Oil
global_stress_gauges.market_impact: Crude below $75 is a massive macro boon for oil importers like India, Japan, and the EU. It cools down current account deficits and input costs for paints, adhesives, and airlines.

global_stress_gauges.name: Sovereign Gold Bullion
global_stress_gauges.market_impact: Central banks (People's Bank of China, Reserve Bank of India, Turkey) are purchasing physical gold at the fastest pace in modern history to hedge against Western weaponization of US Treasury reserves.

global_stress_gauges.name: Global Semiconductor Fab Utilization
global_stress_gauges.market_impact: TSMC 3nm/5nm and CoWoS advanced packaging lines are booked solid through 2026. AI hardware demand is creating unprecedented capital expenditures for ASML, Lam Research, and Nvidia.

global_stress_gauges.name: Baltic Dry Shipping Index
global_stress_gauges.market_impact: Measures ocean transport rates for iron ore, coal, and grains. Current levels confirm stable raw material movements without the shipping cost spikes seen during pandemic bottlenecks.

pressure_headwinds.title: US Corporate IT Discretionary Budget Freezes
pressure_headwinds.reason: US BFSI and retail executives are reprioritizing discretionary software budgets strictly towards generative AI proof-of-concepts, delaying large multi-year digital transformation deals.

pressure_headwinds.title: Universal US Import Tariff Threat (10% - 60%)
pressure_headwinds.reason: Proposed tariff escalations threaten to disrupt integrated global supply chains and reignite US imported consumer inflation.

pressure_headwinds.title: European Industrial Demand Stagnation
pressure_headwinds.reason: With German factory orders and automotive dispatches declining, Indian and Asian exporters of intermediates face delayed purchase orders.

expansion_tailwinds.title: China+1 Manufacturing Relocation to India & ASEAN
expansion_tailwinds.reason: Global multinational brands are mandating that at least 25-30% of their global component sourcing originate outside mainland China.

expansion_tailwinds.title: Muted Crude Oil & Commodity Softness
expansion_tailwinds.reason: Crude oil remaining rangebound ($70-$75) prevents gross margin contraction and keeps national current account deficits in comfortable zones.

expansion_tailwinds.title: Global Central Bank Rate-Easing Liquidity Wave
expansion_tailwinds.reason: Synchronized rate cuts from the ECB, Bank of England, and US Fed lower global borrowing spreads and reduce corporate interest burdens.
